name: agy-client
description: AgyClient - Cross-Platform Control Center & CLI for Google Antigravity (agy)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/server && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/agy-adapter && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/permissions && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/usage && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/process-manager && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/git-manager && npm run build --workspace=@agy-client/orchestrator
